notes.title: One Button, 56 Mini-Games—SUPER 56 Brings the Chaos to Couch Co-op Fest!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Steam’s Couch Co-op Fest is live for one week, and we’re thrilled to announce that SUPER 56 is part of the fun!

If you haven’t played [b]SUPER 56[/b] yet, here’s what your missing out on:

[list]
[*] 56 genre-bending mini-games controlled with just ONE BUTTON.
[*] Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores.
[*] Packed with gaming nostalgia, hilarious references, and all the charm (and WTF moments) of Wario-Ware.
[*] Perfect for your Steam Deck—take the madness on the go!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/d86a6c8a9941ef14c0ad1188d98b61a49aeaf3a5.gif[/img]

[h2]More Players, More Madness![/h2]

Originally a single-player experience, we heard your feedback loud and clear—so we added multiplayer mode! Now, you can gather up to 8 players on one couch (hopefully, it’s a big one) and battle it out for SUPER 56 champion status. Will you top the leaderboard, or will you be the one crying in the corner? 😂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/8a98a5ede695acbb5ad49a9ef88aed6f2c29cee9.gif[/img]

[h2]Gamepads? Where We’re Going, We Don’t Need Gamepads![/h2]

Try MIC MODE and control the game with SOUND! Warm up your vocal cords, grab a frying pan, or just scream your way through 56 mini-games. It’s hilarious, chaotic, and guaranteed to annoy your neighbours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/3346fe81476fe9e46ffb24c2ebe2b2fad80abc15.gif[/img]

[h2]The Sounds of SUPER 56—Anytime, Anywhere![/h2]

Can’t get enough of the SUPER 56 vibes? The official soundtrack is available now! Stream it on [url=https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwvj9iWDi02_N7VP_5OKFTRJNU-4wFIY_]YouTube[/url], [url=https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6Aq42iQ3ZDgj7k29TosKA7?si=d1818fb822cd4b1b&nd=1&dlsi=a21b2425a4644b5e]Spotify[/url], and [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/super-56/1721942499]Apple Music[/url], or grab the OST from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2603160/SUPER_56_Soundtrack/]Steam [/url]and relive the madness anytime.

[h2]Buy SUPER 56 on Steam now[/h2]

So what are you waiting for? Spread the chaos and challenge your friends to a game of SUPER 56 today!

👉[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659150/SUPER_56/] Buy SUPER 56 on Steam now[/url] 👈

notes.title: Wishlist Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Get ready to duck, dodge, and dive into chaos because Nippon Marathon 2 is sprinting onto Steam Early Access in Q2 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/f198e8168256c358fbd813d04819ee240d2084ae.png[/img]

[h2]What's Nippon Marathon?[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/746940/Nippon_Marathon/]Nippon Marathon[/url]  was our first game—a wacky, physics-driven party racer where up to four players sprint, stumble, and soar through Japan’s wildest courses. Think Micro Machines meets the bonkers energy of Takeshi's Castle! 

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
This sequel is bigger, crazier, and packed with even more ridiculous fun:
✨ Vastly improved graphics
✨ Brand-new marathons filled with hazards and surprises
✨ A Create-a-Contestant feature
✨ All the wild Japanese TV energy you love

And if you’re wondering what Daijoubu means—it’s Japanese for “It’s fine!” or “Everything’s under control!”... though trust us, it won’t feel like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/4df61a58289e4f6a2e0dee48974a683b1d008394.gif[/img]

[h2]💾 Wishlist now and get ready for the madness![/h2]
We cannot wait to show you more over the next few months, so for now please Wishlist Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu on Steam today

If you liked the OG Nippon Marathon and the weirdness of SUPER 56, we think you'll definitely like the sequel.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358880]👉 Wishlist on Steam 👈[/url]

[h2]So why Early Access?[/h2]

With Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu, we’re taking a giant leap forward. Every aspect of the game has been rebuilt from the ground up, featuring improved gameplay, greatly enhanced visuals, all new hand-crafted stages and painstakingly detailed characters. Early Access provides an opportunity for us to collaborate with you, our community. Your input via Discord and the Steam Community Forums will be key to making Nippon Marathon 2 the best it can be. We will also be introducing an online mode, which we intend to develop alongside your continued feedback.

We cannot wait to show you more over the next few months, so for now please Wishlist Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu on Steam today

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358880/Nippon_Marathon_2_Daijoubu/]👉 Wishlist on Steam 👈[/url]

Let’s make this the most ridiculous marathon yet! 🦞🐕

Thanks everyone!

Amy & Andy
Onion Soup Interactive

notes.title: When in Rome play SUPER56
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a hot minute since our last update, but fear not – we've been grinding behind the scenes on SUPER56. Here's the lowdown from Onion Soup Interactive HQ (jump to TL;DR):

[h1]WHEN IN ROME, PLAY SUPER56?
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/7b364ac191ec2f56a4b0ce8133a6a308f6086957.png[/img]

We're bringing SUPER56 to the VIDEO GAMES LAB ROME, which runs between Jan 25-28, 2024. Play SUPER56 in Rome by swinging by the Games London Booth, and meet us along with four other cool Indie devs showcasing their awesome games. 

The other devs are:
[list]
[*] Innoloop - Rhythm Towers
[*] Overworld Games Studio - EMITIME
[*] Scribblescape/Queensguard - Shards Between Us
[*] MilkBubblesGames - GladiEATers
[/list]

If you happen to be nearby, come say hi, play SUPER56, and snag some sweet sticker swag! We love stickers ❤️

[h1]INDIEGAMEIAC PLAYS SUPER 56[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/c4f391553683a1fd74075b8a3ed667391472d1f5.png[/img]

If you're not in Rome but want a piece of the action, we've been chosen to be a part of 'IndieGameiac's Virtual Indie Booth'! Catch the stream live at 8 pm (GMT), where IndieGameiac will be showcasing our game and we'll be hanging out in the chat. Get your questions ready!

Link to IndieGameiac's Youtube: [url=https://t.co/QyyURam06j]https://t.co/QyyURam06j[/url]

[h1]GRAB YOUR FAVOURITE COUCH AND SOME FRIENDS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/8a364d5975cda4041e0ebb7e2bc98ae6011fd342.png[/img]

Hold onto your hats – multiplayer mode is in the works! We heard your pleas and added local multiplayer to SUPER56. Currently in Beta testing, we're ironing out the kinks for a seamless experience. You can even sneak a peek at the 'BETA' branch on SUPER56 (no password needed). Stay tuned on Steam and our socials for the big reveal! We're currently working on a trailer that will blow your socks off!

[h1]GENERAL BUG FIXES [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/471cad559ac62573973a0e2fb5435395e8050f82.gif[/img]

We've been on a bug-squashing spree! Added some extra flair to the stages – more guidance, simplifying the more abstract levels, and sprinkling in some extra weirdness. Because who doesn't love a bit of organised chaos?


Keep your eyes peeled for more updates ✨


Thanks again,


Amy & Andy


TL;DR: SUPER56 is being showcased at VIDEO GAMES LAB ROME. Join IndieGameiac's Virtual Indie Booth to watch them stream SUPER56 & join us in the chat. Working on local multiplayer mode, currently in Beta.

notes.title: Get Your Jingle On in the Steam Winter Sale
notes.content:
Hello humans

Hope you're full of holiday cheer, now that the Steam Winter Sale is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/3fda113021613872ccc27dbb661c5ea28c213019.gif[/img]

We're spreading the [strike]joy[/strike] chaos with a 10% discount in the Steam Winter Sale. We know that the holidays are typically all about family, friends, and food, but the holidays are also about [i]gaming[/i]. 

Now a fast paced mini game collection may not be your typical choice for a holiday game, but we guarantee it'll be a great addition to your party game collection, and will leave Grandma asking [i]just what was in the gravy[/i].

We recently added some free content too, so here's a reminder of what was added:

[h2]Mic Control (Experimental)[/h2]
[previewyoutube=EAhPmjWxjYM;full][/previewyoutube]
Ever dreamt of yelling at your game and having it actually listen? Now's your chance! Mic Control lets you boss around SUPER 56 using your microphone – it's like having your own gaming genie. Grab a head-set style mic, maybe a Santa hat too, and let the mayhem commence. 

[h2]Trial Mode - Clean the Whole House:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/de85e44a9feec6af5daff5ab635c7d4756d5cbf4.gif[/img]
Feeling the festive cleaning spirit? Try out the first Trial Mode – Clean the Whole House! Grab the cat-vacuum, channel your inner Mrs. Claus, and compete for cleaning glory. Each trial comes with its own leaderboard, turning tidying up into a festive competition. You might even discover the joy of cleaning... or not.

[h2]New Achievements, Secrets, and Surprises:[/h2]
Unwrap two shiny new achievements tied to the Clean the House Trial. One's a secret – because who doesn't love a bit of mystery during the holidays? Check out the Achievements table to see what challenges await and flex your gaming muscles.

[h2]Leaderboard Shenanigans:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e5fb9e561af3567f53bfc4914a76c4834821ce09.jpg[/img]
Laugh your way through the leaderboards as everyone's witty remarks make an appearance. We admit we spend too much time reading these gems, but it's the holidays – time for some good-natured chuckles!

[h2]Miscellaneous Awesomeness:[/h2]
We've sprinkled in some UI magic and fixed up Simplified Chinese credits. Oh, and about our dear Reiwa man – he's taking a festive break and sent his doppelgänger to keep you company. Is it him? Is it not? The mystery thickens like eggnog.

So, what are you waiting for? Grab your controller, keyboard, drum kit, dog food, doorbell, or mouth, boot up SUPER 56, and make this holiday season the weirdest one yet. May your victories be sweet, your fails be hilarious, and your neighbours forgiving. 

Happy holidays and get playing SUPER 56!

notes.title: SUPER 56 V1.22: SUPER NEW CONTENT UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hey HUMANS! It's time to check out the new features in our latest SUPER 56 update which is available now:

[h1]Mic Control (experimental)[/h1]

[previewyoutube=EAhPmjWxjYM;full][/previewyoutube]

Now you can control the whole game using your microphone input, we find this works best with a head-set style mic so that other sounds don't interfere with your game. We had a real fun time playing SUPER 56 using guitars, dog toys and other random items, it's a total blast!

[h1]Trial Mode - Clean the Whole House[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/de85e44a9feec6af5daff5ab635c7d4756d5cbf4.gif[/img]

We've added the first Trial to the game, in this trial you need to clean the whole house using the cat-vacuum. Each new trial we add will come with its own leaderboard too so please look forward to them. Yeah!

[h1]New Achievements[/h1]

There are two new achievements, both are unlocked via the new Clean the House Trial. One is secret and the other can be unlocked by completing the trial in under 4 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e5fb9e561af3567f53bfc4914a76c4834821ce09.jpg[/img]

There is also a new Achievements table, so you can see the full list of achievements you've unlocked, and need to unlock

[h1]Leaderboard Changes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/db7f0e42a22f2f690ddadd0d68386cd6318b2a9d.jpg[/img]
You'll now see everyone's amusing phrases on their leaderboard entries, I spend too much time looking at these.

[h1]Misc[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e67f78807dd010ac846015e305202d695e63ebaa.jpg[/img]

Various UI and localisation improvements (including fixing the Simplified Chinese credits).
We've also replaced the image of our dear Reiwa man with a delightful 3D model of someone who looks scarily similar, but is.definitely.not.him.... ok?


[h1]Future Development:[/h1]

We're currently splitting our time between adding new content and preparing the game for Nintendo Switch porting. We really hope that SUPER 56 will gain some much needed visibility by being available on Switch and if that is the case it will enable us to bring even more updates to the Steam version.

Thanks again for your continued support!

Andy & Amy

notes.title: v1.14 Patch now live!
notes.content:
Hi all.

Combined in this update are versions 1.13 and 1.14. Patch notes below:

V1.13 patch notes:

Achievements:
- Act Of Kindness achievement now works (unlocks if you have 300 coins or more)
- Players getting B5 achievement for the first time should now be given the correct achievement (instead of Time Lord)
- Players who are already at Rank B Level 6 prior to this update will be given B5 achievement automatically

Gameplay:
- Added an extra 5 seconds to the 'Pay Attention' game, now it should always display at least one 'PRESS' instruction

- On 'Bounce' the stop can now be skipped a maximum of 20 times to stop the player
from running out of time and failing and from gaining too many points on this stage

Sound:
- Sound mixer properly set in the following stages: Fuel the Car, Feed the Baby, Tennis,
Snake

localisation:
- Best player in world is now being pulled from loc sheet (awaiting translations to add into loc sheet)
- Stage score screen TOTAL and STAGE, Giftbag UI Back button, Giftbag duplicate label now properly localised
- RANK and HISCORE on new game config page is now localised when player is offline
- Game control tip at the bottom of the screen switching back to English now fixed

V1.14 patch notes:

- Mapped audio correctly on intro, skijump stage, golf stage, woof, only shoot bad guys, eat 20 apples, look at camera,
- Fixed the Eagle Eye Cherub achievement
- Made the GiftBag contents easier to see by changing the background
- Fixed: Sometimes after viewing Daily Challenge scores the next standard run would incorrectly save the score to the Daily Challenge leaderboard

More fixes to come, please leave any bug reports in the discussion forum
